summary: Build practical competency frameworks, role profiles, and skills matrices. Learn through hands-on exercises and apply the results immediately.
lede: Competency framework development defines the knowledge, skills, behaviors and proficiency levels required for specific roles. For HR and workforce professionals building or applying competency models for hiring, development or performance systems, the course covers role profiling, competency dictionaries and proficiency scales, then shows how to map competencies to roles, assess skills gaps and prepare manager rollout materials.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who build, review, or apply competency models in hiring, development, and performance systems.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of HR processes, job descriptions, and basic workforce planning concepts. Prior experience with competency mapping, learning needs analysis, or performance management is helpful but not required. No coding is required, and the practical exercises focus on framework design, role analysis, and structured documentation using spreadsheets or template-based tools. Advanced concepts such as skills taxonomy design and AI-assisted workforce analytics are covered at operational awareness level, not technical engineering level.
